d: Uttar pradesh ke chandauli men BJP vidhayak Sushil Singh ke kaphile ke sath bara sarak hadsa huaa. bihar ke mokama men vidhayak Anant Singh ki beti ke shadi samaroh men shamil hokar laut rahe Sushil Singh ke kaphile men tej raphtar saphed Scorpio ghus gaee. is dauran Scorpio ne kaphile ki do Fortuner aur ek any Scorpio ko takkar mar di.
